name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: The biggest movement this period is a sharp 7-day pullback: leads dropped 75% and spend fell 42.54% week-over-week, driving CPL up 129.83%, which strongly suggests a budget pause or campaign throttling rather than a demand issue. Over the full 28 days, 16 leads were generated at a $98.87 CPL across $1,581.97 in spend, with Google's top campaign "BWS-Heating-Search-Calls" carrying $447.48 of that load.

performance.verdict: 9 overdue milestones—not an ads problem, a delivery crisis.

findings.text: 9 SOW milestones overdue dating to 2026-07-31, including intake owner confirmation, heating campaigns, LSA re-enable, and fall creative—each blocks revenue or attribution.

CPL spiked 129.83% week-over-week; last 3 days (Oct 13–15) produced 1 lead on $133.81 spend vs prior 3 days (Oct 10–12) yielding 0 leads on $133.06—efficiency is structurally broken at current pacing.
Google spend collapsed to $0 on Oct 14 and averaged $14.43/day over last 7 days vs $31.10 prior 7—likely throttle or campaign pause, not demand weakness; heating season now active.
GBP actions hit zero for 5 consecutive days (Oct 11–15) after averaging 5.3/day Oct 1–10—organic visibility collapsed coinciding with zero paid support, compounding lead drought.

GHL shows 765 opportunities created vs only 59 won (7.7% close rate) with 0 appointments logged—intake leak or absent dispatch owner (Vivian left 7/7) is suppressing booked jobs independent of ad volume.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner GHL login and after-hours coverage before any budget restoration—unblocks scale-up gate.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and the intake owner seat is still unconfirmed per the SOW gate flagged for Aug 31. With 765 GHL opportunities created but only 59 won and 0 appointments logged, leads are arriving but not converting to bookings—this is an ops gap, not an ads gap. Action: Nacer to confirm who owns intake, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage is in place. Success check: named intake owner with active GHL login confirmed to Sohib by 2026-10-20.

suggestions.text: Watch Google daily spend recovery; do not raise budgets until intake owner is confirmed per SOW scale-back-up gate.
suggestions.monday_update: Google spend dropped to $0 on Oct 14 and averaged only $14.43/day over the last 7 days—heating season is active and BWS-Heating-Search-Calls carried $447.48 of the last 28-day load, so the channel has demonstrated capacity. However, the SOW explicitly blocks budget increases until the intake owner is confirmed (overdue since Aug 31). Re-check Google daily spend and lead count on 2026-10-19; if intake is confirmed by then, escalate a budget restoration proposal to Sohib.

suggestions.text: Escalate 9 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer/Sohib; heating campaigns and LSA re-enable are revenue-critical at 45+ days late.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine milestones are overdue, the oldest since 2026-07-31 (booking bot battle-test) and the most revenue-critical being LSA re-enable (due Sep 1), heating campaigns on Google and Meta (due Oct 1), and fall creative package (due Sep 30). With GBP actions at zero for 5 straight days and CPL up 129.83% week-over-week, every week without these live is direct lost revenue in peak heating season. Action: Sohib to present a consolidated status update to Nader/Aiman/Xavier by 2026-10-19 with a revised go-live date for each milestone.
